answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to a fresh, unpredictable challenge answered by a prescribed chain of modular squarings, each dependent on the previous result. GPUs may run clone chains concurrently, but cannot reduce the sequential delay of an individual chain; producing many identities therefore requires proportionate hardware-time. A Wesolowski proof lets peers verify completion efficiently. The vault, bridge, and garden are labels, not shortcuts around this cost.
